# Adding MESACLIP to CDEPS

*Generated by Claude.*

The changes are three stacked PRs on [manishvenu/CDEPS](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS), one
per component, each on top of the previous and all based on `cdeps1.0.101` (the CDEPS tag CESM's
`crocodash` branch uses):

| PR | Branch | Base | Adds |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#1](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/pull/1) | `mesaclip-datm` | `main` | DATM mode and `DATM_MESACLIP_CASE` |
| [#2](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/pull/2) | `mesaclip-docn` | `mesaclip-datm` | DOCN mode |
| [#3](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/pull/3) | `mesaclip-dice` | `mesaclip-docn` | DICE mode |

DOCN and DICE need #1 for `DATM_MESACLIP_CASE`. `mesaclip-dice` holds all three, and this repo
carries it as the `cdeps/` submodule. `code/claude/add_mesaclip_to_cesm.py` regenerates the XML and
registration edits; the datamode Fortran is edited on the branches.

```bash
cd <cesm>/components/cdeps
git remote add mesawave https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS.git
git fetch mesawave && git checkout mesaclip-dice
```

Most of the PR is standard data-model entry: compset modes, namelist values and stream
definitions (one stream per variable, see [Supply: MESACLIP to the coupler](stream_construction.md)). This page
covers what goes beyond that.

## Five products

Each MESACLIP scenario is its own mode in DATM, DOCN and DICE, so a compset picks one scenario,
e.g. `DATM%MESACLIP-RCP85`, `DOCN%MESACLIP-RCP85`, `DICE%MESACLIP-RCP85`.

| Compset option | `DATM_MODE` | `DOCN_MODE`, `DICE_MODE` | GDEX dataset | Default member | Years |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MESACLIP-HIST` | `MESACLIP_HIST` | `mesaclip_hist` | d651007 | 010 | 1920–2005 |
| `MESACLIP-RCP26` | `MESACLIP_RCP26` | `mesaclip_rcp26` | d651043 | 003 | 2006–2099 |
| `MESACLIP-RCP45` | `MESACLIP_RCP45` | `mesaclip_rcp45` | d651043 | 003 | 2006–2099 |
| `MESACLIP-RCP60` | `MESACLIP_RCP60` | `mesaclip_rcp60` | d651008 | 010 | 2006–2095 |
| `MESACLIP-RCP85` | `MESACLIP_RCP85` | `mesaclip_rcp85` | d651009 | 010 | 2006–2099 |

The years are the defaults for `DATM_YR_START` and `DATM_YR_END`, which DOCN and DICE also use,
with `DATM_YR_ALIGN = $DATM_YR_START` so model years are data years. RCPs stop at 2099 because the
name of the 2100 file differs between members, and RCP 6.0 stops at 2095 because its last ocean file
does too. `DATM_TOPO` is `observed`.

## Runs to 2100

CDEPS's year templates (`%y`) can't name these files: each holds one variable over a date range
(`UBOT.2095010100-2096010100.nc`, ten-year ocean and ice chunks), and members end in different
years, so the stream definitions list every file explicitly and only cover shared names. A run that
needs other years lists its member's own files in the case, through `user_nl_*_streams`:

```bash
python code/claude/mesaclip_case_streams.py <caseroot> RCP60 b.e13.BRCP60C5.ne120_t12.cesm-ihesp-hires1.0.46-2006-2100.009
./xmlchange DATM_YR_END=2100
```

It writes `<stream>:datafiles = ...` for every MESACLIP stream and reports years the member has no
file for (RCP 8.5 member 005 lacks 2096 `UBOT`).

## XML variable: `DATM_MESACLIP_CASE`

The GDEX case name to read, which picks the ensemble member. It is in `env_run.xml`, and every
DATM, DOCN and DICE MESACLIP stream file path contains `$DATM_MESACLIP_CASE`, so one setting
switches all three components. Defaults are the members in the table above. To use another member:

```bash
./xmlchange DATM_MESACLIP_CASE=b.e13.BHISTC5.ne120_t12.cesm-ihesp-hires1.0.46-1920-2005.005
```

`code/claude/add_mesaclip_to_cesm.py` reports which members have every file the streams list;
members that don't can still run with [their own file lists](#runs-to-2100).

## Datamode code

Each component gets a `mesaclip` datamode, registered in its cap and `CMakeLists.txt`. Each is a
copy of an existing datamode, and every change from the copy is marked `MESACLIP:`. What each
field ends up as, with formulas and line links, is in the
[supply tables](stream_construction.md#from-mesaclip-to-the-coupler).

| Datamode | Copied from | Changes from the copy |
|---|---|---|
| [`datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90`](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/d89a217fb9678fadc0e7dbf9477f0d362a93fddd/datm/datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90) | CPLHIST | computes `Sa_ptem`, `Sa_dens`, rain, snow, direct shortwave; adds `Sa_u10m`, `Sa_v10m` |
| [`docn_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90`](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/5943971ec71003a8d304590f8ca4e47fbe683bbb/docn/docn_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90) | CPLHIST | current units (cm/s → m/s); adds `So_s`; `So_bldepth` 0 instead of a fill value without a stream |
| [`dice_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90`](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/69388de1d1c06ff68459ee6e9b335a7cc60e4cdd/dice/dice_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90) | SSMI | ice fraction units (% → fraction); adds `Si_thick` from `hi_d` |
